## Added

- **Seamless Grilling → Propose.** When a grilling turn finishes and writes its brainstorm, Readyset asks whether to continue with Explore & Propose right there. No second `/readyset` run, no re-picking the file from the picker — and staying in the same session means the same prompt cache prefix carries forward.
- **On-demand review & archive.** Once omp has finished implementing, run `/readyset --review <change-id>` to evaluate the risk triggers against the working tree, run the review turn, write `REVIEW.md`, and archive the change.

## Changed

- **Readyset now ends at the Review Gate.** Approving a change hands execution off to core omp instead of running Readyset's own apply/review loop. The change's `tasks.md` is still what gets executed — you just get omp's native runtime doing it, so subagents, parallel tool calls, and live task-checklist updates behave the way they normally do.

## Fixed

- `--review <change-id>` followed by another flag (e.g. `--lane fast`) no longer treats the flag as a change id.
- Reopening the gate on an already-applied change no longer reports false `NEW-BUT-EXISTS` / `DELETE-BUT-MISSING` contract warnings, or fires a repair turn against executed work.

## Install / Update

```
npx readyset-flow install
npx readyset-flow update
```
or with `bunx` in place of `npx`.

The extension module is referenced in place, so updating the package is enough — no re-install needed.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/fresp/readyset-flow/compare/v0.15.0...v0.16.0
